outfits.name: Festive Christmas dress
outfits.description: Knit red sweater-dress with off-the-shoulder white collar, long sleeves with wide white cuffs, and two small white buttons at the chest. A thin black belt cinches the waist, accented by a small white bow. The flared skirt has a wide white fluffy hem with a small holly leaf embroidery near the bottom right. White thigh-high stockings and brown lace-up boots complete the cozy holiday look.

outfits.name: Celestial gothic ensemble
outfits.description: Black dress with gold star-patterned embroidery and scalloped gold trim along the collar, skirt edges, and cuffs. Puffed short sleeves and a small bow at the collar. The dress features a front opening at the skirt revealing black shorts with a gold-buckled belt underneath. Black thigh-high stockings with gold garter straps, finished with sleek white knee-high boots accented with gold details. On the back, there are small black cute devil wings, and a black devil tail.

outfits.name: Gym athleisure fit
outfits.description: Coordinated athleisure gym look in cool cyan-and-violet tones against black basics. A cropped, boxy short-sleeve tee in a cyan-to-teal gradient ends just below the bust, leaving the midriff exposed over a plain black bandeau sports bra. Black high-waisted athletic leggings with a wide waistband carry a bright electric-purple panel on the outer right thigh and thin purple piping down both outer seams. Chunky black-and-grey low-top trainers with light aqua accents on the laces and tongue trim, finished with thick white midsoles. For workouts, sports, or a sporty casual day out.

outfits.name: Swimsuit
outfits.description: Swimsuit — a halter-neck triangle bikini in a muted botanical camo print: mottled olive, khaki, sage and sand tones broken up by darker leaf-like shapes, a soft military-floral look rather than a bright beachwear print. Shaped cups with slight gathering at the centre and ties running up to the back of the neck, with matching side-tie briefs knotted at each hip. Barefoot. The same suit Eve owns — matching beach fits. For the beach, pool, hot springs or any swimming and summer-sun scene.

gestures.name: Backflip with Eve
gestures.description: Synchronized backflip with Eve — she appears at your side and you both backflip at exactly the same time. Use when the captain asks you two for a trick, a stunt, or to show off together.
